parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup plan. Call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: EndTimestamp
parameters.description: The end timestamp of the backup query time range, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 0, and the default is 0.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

> Default value: 30.

parameters.name: ShowStorageType
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the storage class. Valid values:

- true

- false

> Default value: true.

parameters.name: StartTimestamp
parameters.description: The start timestamp of the backup query time range, in milliseconds.
